title: A meeting on the calendar carries an agenda and notes, and Vera turns the notes into to-dos

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; owner ask 2026-11-24 17:35Z: AI meeting and date management so everyone can brainstorm the best date and time)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: the calendar has events, pencils, private and unavailable time, but no meeting: a team call has nowhere for an agenda, notes or follow-ups. Fix: a 'meeting' entry kind (one value added to the kind check, per the private calendar layer's own rule) with agenda and notes; after the meeting Vera reads the notes and proposes to-dos with assignees and due dates through the existing vera-command 'todo' change, which a person ticks and accepts.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
